verdict_reason: The code-and-Latin-name title is correct and tested, but the same format is duplicated in the animal-identification card view model.

todos.issue: The species card title format (code, then ' — ' and the Latin name when there is one) is written twice: speciesCardTitle here (lines 11-18) and cardTitleOf in features/commodities/animal-identification/card/view-model.js:18-22. This PR rewrote both bodies, so the two pages can drift on the same card title.
todos.fix: Must: one function owns the commodity-line card title, and the check-answers card and the animal-identification card both call it. One way: export the title function from the shared species-display module (see the species-latin-name.js finding) and have speciesCardTitle keep only its NOT_APPLICABLE fallback, with cardTitleOf deleted.
